snippet.title: Sengoku Dynasty | Console Release Trailer (ENG)
snippet.description:
Sengoku Dynasty is the ultimate feudal Japan experience: build villages, grow your community, and shape the open world through combat or economy. The choice is yours alone - or that of up to 4 players in multiplayer co-op!

Celebrate the console release with the brand new trailer.

► Sengoku Dynasty on PlayStation 5: https://bit.ly/Sengoku-Dynasty_PlayStation-5
► Sengoku Dynasty on Xbox Series X|S: https://bit.ly/Sengoku-Dynasty_Xbox-Series
► Sengoku Dynasty on Steam: https://bit.ly/Sengoku-Dynasty_Steam-PC

About Toplitz Productions

Named after the mystic “Toplitz Lake” which is situated in a dense mountain forest high up in the Alps, Toplitz Productions was founded with the aim of developing and publishing computer and video games “with heart and soul”.
For more information, visit toplitz-productions.com.
